description: Shows an Oculix status page on a subdomain such as status.example.com: a CNAME to the Oculix server, and the TXT record that shows the domain belongs to the page.
variableDescription: target is the Oculix server the subdomain points at (the hosted service's domains.oculix.live, or a self-hosted server's own address); token is the page's own code for the TXT record, shown on its domain settings.
